lines.r-hello: And I'm the reviewer. When something sounds wrong, I'll name the [WCAG](/wˈʌkæɡ/) criterion it falls under, say why it matters, and explain what changed in the code to fix it.
lines.r-open: This video is about [WCAG](/wˈʌkæɡ/) one point one point one, Non-text Content. Anything shown as a picture, like a chart, needs a text alternative that gives a listener what the picture gives a viewer.
lines.r-finding: That's a problem under [WCAG](/wˈʌkæɡ/) one point one point one. The chart has no text alternative, so VoiceOver falls back to its file name. If you're listening, you know there's a picture, but not that sales went up every month.
lines.r-fix: In the code, the image now has alt text. It says it's a bar chart, what it measures, and the three numbers. The chart looks exactly the same.
lines.r-holds: A listener gets what the chart shows. One point one point one holds here.
